## piscout v0.1.9

Windows desktop tool for Raspberry Pi on your LAN: auto-discovery, built-in SSH terminal, remote desktop, overview and batch actions, SD card flashing, multilingual UI (中文 / English / हिन्दी, more welcome).

### What changed since v0.1.8
- **Hindi (हिन्दी) UI**, contributed by @Aaqibhafeezkhan in #12. Thank you! It covers the most visible screens; anything not translated yet shows English, and the installer follows your Windows language as before. More languages are welcome: see [docs/TRANSLATING.md](docs/TRANSLATING.md) and the open [language issue](https://github.com/MilkteaTW1/piscout/issues/11). Urdu and Arabic are on the way.

### Download
`piscout-setup.exe` (recommended) or the single-file `piscout.exe`. Verify with the `.sha256` files.

> Neither is **code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn: *More info → Run anyway*.
> They are built by GitHub Actions from this repository's source at the tagged commit.

Everything else is unchanged from v0.1.8, including what was and was not verified on real hardware.

## 繁體中文
相較 v0.1.8：新增 **印地語（हिन्दी）介面**，由 @Aaqibhafeezkhan 貢獻（#12），非常感謝！目前涵蓋最常見的畫面，尚未翻譯的文字會顯示英文。歡迎貢獻更多語言，見 [docs/TRANSLATING.md](docs/TRANSLATING.md)。
其他內容與 v0.1.8 相同。檔案沒有簽章，SmartScreen 可能警告，按「其他資訊 → 仍要執行」。
